_meta.category: Personal Finance Lifecycle — Every Money Decision from 18 to 80
_meta.description: Comprehensive personal finance data covering earning, spending, saving/investing, debt, and retirement across the full adult lifecycle. Covers 35 subcategories including starting salaries by field, salary growth curves, negotiation, side hustles, passive income, gender pay gap, certification premiums, expenses by life stage, subscriptions, impulse buying, lifestyle inflation, wedding/child/pet costs, emergency funds, 401k/pension rates, savings by age, investment returns, index vs active, DCA vs lump sum, advisor ROI, student loans, credit cards, mortgages, auto loans, medical debt, bankruptcy, retirement savings, Social Security, healthcare costs, FIRE movement, and pension coverage.
_meta.sources_summary: NACE, BLS, Pew Research, Federal Reserve, Fidelity, Vanguard, Experian, Bankrate, OECD, S&P SPIVA, McKinsey, Empower, Harvard Business Review, Kaiser Family Foundation, USDA, SSA
